examined_formations.title: WEB_ACCESS_PROXY_AND_UNBLOCKING_FEEDBACK_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 网页访问代理与反爬成功率反馈网络
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Bright Data publishes pay-as-you-go and monthly residential proxy pricing, including $499, $999 and $1,999 monthly tiers.
examined_formations.day_one_value: A single customer receives immediate access/routing value without needing a new entrant to have a large customer network first.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Requests can create target-domain, geography, IP-pool, anti-bot and success-rate observations that improve later routing.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Aggregate target and route-performance observations can be non-sensitive when collected lawfully, but network and access operations carry target-site terms and compliance constraints.

examined_formations.title: SELF_HEALING_BROWSER_WORKFLOW_CACHE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 浏览器自动化自愈与跨运行缓存
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Browserbase publishes paid Developer, Startup and Scale plans with browser-hour, agent, search and fetch usage.
examined_formations.day_one_value: A first workflow can immediately automate a live website with hosted browsers, captcha support and agent tooling.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Repeated runs can validate selectors/actions and create reusable action/observation/extraction cache entries, lowering later inference cost and increasing reliability.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Public-page workflow resolution can be non-sensitive; authenticated workflows can contain customer-specific/private state and cannot be assumed reusable.

examined_formations.title: PRODUCT_TO_HS_CODE_CLASSIFICATION_GRAPH
examined_formations.chinese_title: 商品到HS税则编码分类图谱
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Avalara Item Classification is explicitly a billable service exposed through production APIs.
examined_formations.day_one_value: One merchant can immediately submit product attributes and receive classification output without a network cold start.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Resolved product-to-code classifications and later corrections can improve future classification quality for similar goods.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Generic product taxonomy mappings can be reusable, but customer SKU metadata may be confidential and managed classifications can involve operator review.

examined_formations.title: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DELIVERABILITY_SIGNAL_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 邮箱验证与送达风险信号网络
examined_formations.payer_evidence: ZeroBounce currently charges from $39 for 2,000 verification credits and sells recurring subscriptions and enterprise volume plans.
examined_formations.day_one_value: A first list can be validated immediately.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Verification attempts can improve domain/provider heuristics, disposable-domain intelligence and response-pattern knowledge.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Individual email addresses are identifying customer data; broad cross-customer retention/reuse cannot be assumed to be non-sensitive or rights-clear.

examined_formations.title: BUSINESS_PHONE_REPUTATION_MONITORING_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业电话号码信誉监测网络
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Hiya describes Number Reputation API access as a premium service and states service fees may apply per business and per reputation request.
examined_formations.day_one_value: An authorized business can immediately inspect spam-label risk and engagement metrics for registered numbers.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Repeated registration/reputation observations can strengthen number-behavior and reputation knowledge.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Hiya requires authorization documentation when a service provider monitors numbers used by other companies; access itself requires a service agreement.

examined_formations.title: UNIFIED_API_CONNECTOR_MAINTENANCE_GRAPH
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Merge currently offers the first three production linked accounts free and charges $650/month for up to ten on its Launch plan, with contract pricing above that.
examined_formations.day_one_value: A customer can add production integrations faster by building once against a unified schema.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Each integration, schema change, sync failure and resolution can strengthen reusable connector mappings, compatibility knowledge and observability playbooks.
examined_formations.permission_and_sensitivity: Connector specifications and generalized failure fixes are reusable; customer credentials and synced records remain private.
